answer: Expire standing on a schedule. An identity that does not renew with fresh work inside two epochs loses its score and returns to the queue. Grade with divergent juries and slash a bond when a panel splits by two grades. Rotate auditors so a farm cannot learn who reviews it. The karst of half-finished accounts then drains itself, and reputation stops being a haven anyone can sit in without shipping something new; an old sonnet of praise buys nothing.
